correctness.rationale: The equilibrium branch is uniquely determined by atanh(b)/b=beta(1-mu), whose left side increases. Direct differentiation of the full original 2D vector field yields diagonal eigenvalues beta*mu*b*(1-b^2)-1 and beta*(1-mu)*(1-b^2)-1, times alpha, with the latter strictly negative. Eliminating mu gives a threshold B(b) with exactly one minimum because its derivative numerator N has N′>0, N(0+)=-1 and N(1-)=2. This establishes exactly two hyperbolic transverse transitions when beta>beta_star and none when beta<beta_star. The independent finite-difference reconstruction agrees at representative states, but is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact second stability window changes the qualitative interpretation of a currently investigated platform-segregation model: a parameter region described as exclusively integrated includes two locally attracting segregated fixed points. An all-exploration-strength necessary-and-sufficient threshold explains when that reentrant mechanism exists. The 0.005 parameter scan misses a real interval smaller than 0.001, so the result is a motivated analytical boundary, not an arbitrary numerical special case.
